name: stat
description: One labelled number with an optional one-line explanation, in a flat bordered tile. Tone colours the icon only.

properties.value: Label, then value, then description — a screen reader hears "Ready, 2, You meet the expectation".
Tone colours the decorative icon only; the label always names the meaning, so colour is never the only signal.
Decorative (aria-hidden). Don't put meaning in the icon that the label doesn't say.
All text uses neutral text tokens on a white surface (AA).

constraints: Use for a small set of counts or totals shown side by side (2–4 tiles).
Keep the label short and the description to one line — it explains the number, not the feature.
Use tone only when the number has a clear meaning (success = good to go, warning = needs attention); otherwise neutral.
Never colour the value or label text — tone reaches the icon only.
Place tiles in a grid; the tile fills its cell.

doNot.wrong: Show a percentage built from missing data (e.g. readiness 0% when nothing is assessed)
doNot.correct: Show the counts behind it, including the ones that can't be judged yet

doNot.wrong: Colour the number red or amber
doNot.correct: Use tone on the icon and let the label name the state

doNot.wrong: Put actions or links inside the tile
doNot.correct: Keep tiles read-only; put actions next to the group

relatedComponents.name: card
relatedComponents.reason: Card is a general container; Stat is one number with a label.

relatedComponents.name: badge
relatedComponents.reason: Badge labels a state inline; Stat shows a count.

notes: No warning-coloured text token exists for white surfaces, so tone is carried by the icon (color/icon/*).

changelog.change: Created Stat for the My Career progress board.
Story copy: "Needs evidence" → "Needs records" to match My Career (records are what employees add). No API or visual change.
Story copy: "Needs records" → "Not assessed yet" (scores come from Assessment; the Records module was dropped). No API or visual change.

Text uses Enpath text styles (text-body-sm, text-heading-md …, see Foundations/Text Styles) instead of mixed size and weight classes. Labels (label-*) and small headings (heading-sm/xs) are Medium 500.
Tile gets shadow/surface (was border only), so Stat lifts off the page like a Card.

docs.intro:
# Stat

One labelled number with an optional one-line explanation, in a flat bordered tile. Tone colours the icon only.

---

sections.title: Structure
sections.body:
```
Stat — tile; vertical stack, gap spacing/component/xs, padding spacing/component/md
├─ label — optional icon (tone colour) + text
├─ value — the number
└─ description — optional one line
```

---

sections.title: Token Bindings
sections.body:
| Frame | Property | Token |
|---|---|---|
| Tile | Fill | `color/surface/default` |
| Tile | Border | `color/border/default` |
| Tile | Radius | `radius/surface` |
| Tile | Padding | `spacing/component/md` |
| Tile | Gap | `spacing/component/xs` |
| Label | Text | `color/text/secondary` |
| Label | Icon gap | `spacing/component/xs` |
| Icon — neutral | Fill | `color/icon/muted` |
| Icon — success | Fill | `color/icon/success` |
| Icon — warning | Fill | `color/icon/warning` |
| Value | Text | `color/surface/default/foreground` |
| Description | Text | `color/text/secondary` |
